rule.assert: DIP1;ERROR;The mets/@OBJID attribute is mandatory, its value is a string identifier for the METS document. Note that the value of the `mets/@OBJID attribute` for the DIP is expected to be different from the SIP and AIP to reflect the creation of a new package.
DIP2;ERROR;The mets/@PROFILE attribute MUST contain the URL of the METS profile that the information package conforms with.
